# Changelog / 更新

## 1.9.2 — First public release / 首个开源版本

- Claude edition: Chinese input automatically becomes a Japanese draft in Claude; Japanese replies are translated into the reading panel on the right.
- General edition: independent Chinese → Japanese + English and Japanese / English → Chinese translation.
- Keeps Windows voice typing, explicit user-controlled sending, verified draft clearing, independent dark floating panels and stable reply-reading position.
- Removes automatic startup, background launch watching, dashboard and time-zone functionality from the public distribution.
- Adds Chinese and English documentation, Windows build scripts, portable packages and 195 automated checks.

主要体验是 Claude 双向对话：中文输入自动译成日文填入，日文回复在右侧自动译成中文。另提供通用翻译版。保留系统听写、手动确认发送、发送后清空、独立悬浮窗和阅读位置修正；公开版排除自动启动、总控台和时区修改。

# Yuqiao · 语桥 ### Type Chinese. Japanese appears in Claude. Read replies in Chinese alongside it. A two-way translation companion for Claude on Windows.
**Automatic draft filling · Side-by-side translated replies · No copy-paste loop** [简体中文](README.md) · **English** [Download for Windows](https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate/releases/latest) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Compatibility](#compatibility) ![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%20%2F%2011-0078D4?style=flat-square) ![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-75c8b8?style=flat-square) ![No LLM key](https://img.shields.io/badge/LLM%20API%20key-not%20required-6654c7?style=flat-square)
Write or dictate Chinese in Yuqiao, and **Japanese appears directly in Claude's message box**. After you send it, Claude's Japanese reply is **translated automatically in the Chinese reading panel on the right**, together with your original Chinese question. **Connect what you want to say with what comes back.** Keep the conversation moving without shuttling text between a translator and a chat window. ![Illustrated Claude workflow: Chinese input, Japanese draft filling, and Chinese replies alongside the conversation](docs/workflow.svg) No large language model, model credits, or LLM API key to configure. Translation uses conventional Microsoft / Google online machine translation: **an internet connection is required; this is not an offline translator.** ## Claude edition: a connected conversation workflow **Designed around the complete Claude Windows desktop workflow: composing, reading replies, navigating the sidebar and understanding settings.** Supported behavior includes: - **Speak Chinese, prepare Japanese.** Translation begins after an input pause and fills the Japanese result into Claude. Japanese and English outputs use the appropriate punctuation. - **You choose when to send.** Translation and filling alone never send. Your explicit Enter requests sending; IME candidate confirmation does not. Shift + Enter inserts a line break. - **Start the next thought cleanly.** The local draft clears only after the corresponding user message is observed in Claude, preventing the next dictation from appending to the previous sentence. - **Keep the caret where it belongs.** After filling, focus returns to Claude for Enter and Backspace. Click the Chinese input to edit it; dictation keeps focus locally. - **Read at your own pace.** Your Chinese question remains in the reader, followed by the translated answer. Incoming answer updates do not drag you to the last line. - **Understand the interface.** A companion panel translates visible sidebar, profile-menu and settings labels into Chinese without modifying Claude. “Complete workflow” refers to these listed features. It is **not a guarantee for every Claude version or every screen**: application updates, layout changes, window sizes and accessibility information can affect integration. ## Choose an edition | | **Claude edition · Main experience** | General edition | |---|---|---| | Core experience | Chinese input → Japanese in Claude; Japanese replies → Chinese on the right | Independent text translation | | Voice | Windows voice typing → translation → automatic filling | Windows voice typing → translation | | Reading and interface | Your Chinese originals + translated replies; independent floating panels | Dark window, always-on-top and copy controls | | Languages | Chinese → Japanese / English; Japanese replies → Chinese | Chinese → Japanese + English; Japanese / English → Chinese | | Download | **Yuqiao-Claude-v1.9.2-windows.zip** | **Yuqiao-General-v1.9.2-windows.zip** | General works independently when an application has no integration; it does not read or control other apps. Both are portable, manually launched applications. Neither includes automatic startup, a background launch watcher, a control dashboard, or changes to the system time zone. ## Quick start 1. Choose an edition on the [Releases page](https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate/releases/latest), then **extract the entire ZIP**. 2. Open **Yuqiao.General.exe** or **Yuqiao.Claude.exe**. No Python, Node.js or local language model installation is needed. 3. In General, select a language direction and type. In Claude, first open Claude for Windows, select “Claude 客户端”, enable automatic translation / filling, and enter floating mode when needed. For speech, select a Chinese Windows input method, then click “语音输入” (Voice input). Recognition is provided by **Windows + H voice typing**. End dictation from the Windows panel. Availability depends on the system language, microphone and online speech settings. Before sending, review the Japanese draft. Edit the Chinese source, review alternatives, or edit the Japanese directly in Claude. The companion avoids overwriting a draft it does not own. ## Compatibility | Environment | Status | |---|---| | Windows 11 x64 | Local build, automated checks and desktop validation environment | | Windows 10 with .NET Framework 4.8 | Intended runtime; not separately verified on a physical machine | | Claude for Windows | Primary integration, with the workflow listed above | | Claude website | Automatic following and filling are not formally supported; General remains usable as a separate translator | | macOS / Linux / Windows ARM | Unverified; no supported package or compatibility claim | This release presents only Claude for Windows as its validated conversation integration. Other AI applications without verified end-to-end workflows are not advertised as supported. The interface is primarily Chinese; README and quick-start documentation are bilingual. This independent project is not affiliated with Anthropic, Microsoft or Google. ## How it works, and where text goes The Claude edition uses Windows **UI Automation**, the operating system's accessibility interface, to read visible text from the selected application and track conversation identity. Conventional translation services convert text; Windows interfaces handle placement and filling. No LLM is required to interpret or operate the screen. - **Online processing:** text goes to Microsoft, with Google as a fallback. Explicit alternative Japanese candidates also use Google. Windows dictation may use Microsoft's online services according to your system settings. - **No saved chat files:** drafts, translations and recent conversation indexes remain in memory. The Claude edition saves only app selection and panel preferences in the local application-data folder. - **Diagnostics are off by default:** opt-in diagnostics contain operational fields such as type, text length, timing and provider, not original text, translations or audio. - **Latency varies:** translations aim to appear within a few seconds after an input pause, but 3–4 seconds is not guaranteed. Public service endpoints may be limited, changed or withdrawn; permanent free access and availability are not promised. See [Architecture & validation](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for implementation and test details. ## Build from source Requires Windows, .NET Framework 4.8 and PowerShell. Uses the system C# compiler with no additional package dependencies. ~~~powershell .\build.ps1 .\tests\Run-Tests.ps1 .\scripts\Package.ps1 -SkipBuild ~~~ Executables are written to dist/; distributable ZIP files go to release/. Build one edition with **-Edition General** or **-Edition Claude**. There are **195 automated checks**: 174 for the Claude workflow and 21 for General. They use synthetic text and simulated services and do not send real chat messages. Live service availability, speech recognition accuracy and future application versions still require real-world validation. ## Contribute Bug reports, adapter improvements and translation-workflow ideas are welcome. Include your Windows version, target app version, edition and reproduction steps. Remove personal information and private conversations from screenshots first. Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE). The software license does not replace third-party translation-service terms.

# 语桥 · Yuqiao ### 中文输入，日文直达 Claude。回复一来，右侧读中文。 为 Claude Windows 客户端准备的双向翻译伴侣。
**自动填入对话框 · 回复同步翻译 · 无需来回复制粘贴** **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) [下载 Windows 版](https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate/releases/latest) · [三步上手](#三步上手) · [适配范围](#适配范围) ![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%20%2F%2011-0078D4?style=flat-square) ![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-75c8b8?style=flat-square) ![No LLM key](https://img.shields.io/badge/LLM%20API%20key-not%20required-6654c7?style=flat-square)
你在语桥中打中文或说中文，**日文自动出现在 Claude 的输入框里**。你自行发送后，Claude 的日文回答会**同步翻译到右侧中文阅读窗**，连同你自己的中文原话一起保留。 **从“我想说什么”到“它回答了什么”，把输入与阅读接成一段连续的对话。** 不必在翻译网站和聊天窗口之间反复搬运文字，也不必为了读新回复不断复制粘贴。 ![Claude 双向翻译流程示意：中文输入，日文自动填入，回复在右侧同步译成中文](docs/workflow.svg) 无需配置大模型、购买大模型额度或填写 API Key。翻译使用 Microsoft / Google 普通在线机器翻译服务，**需要联网，并非离线翻译**。 ## Claude 适配版：把整段对话连起来 **针对 Claude Windows 桌面的输入、回复阅读、目录和设置，提供完整对话流程适配。** 已验证的流程包括： - **说中文，填日文。** 中文输入停顿后自动翻译，日文就绪后填入 Claude；日文、英文分别使用相应标点。 - **发送由你决定。** 自动翻译和填入不会发送。你主动按 Enter 才请求发送；中文输入法选字不会误发，Shift + Enter 可换行。 - **下一句话，重新开始。** 确认 Claude 出现本轮用户消息后，清空本地草稿，避免下轮录音接在上一句后面。 - **光标回到对话。** 自动填入后默认回到 Claude，回车和退格作用于 Claude。需要改中文时，点回中文输入框；听写期间保留本地焦点。 - **读到哪里，留在哪里。** 保留自己的中文原话，随后接上回答译文；新回答不会强制把阅读位置拖到最后。 - **界面也能看懂。** 在旁边显示 Claude 目录、头像菜单和设置的中文提示；按可见界面元素排列，不修改 Claude 本身。 这里的“完整流程”指上述明确列出的功能。Claude 更新、页面布局、窗口尺寸和无障碍信息变化仍可能影响适配，**不代表覆盖所有版本和所有界面**。 ## 两个版本，按需选择 | | **Claude 适配版 · 主要推荐** | 通用即时翻译版 | |---|---|---| | 核心体验 | 中文输入 → 日文自动填入 Claude；日文回复 → 右侧自动译为中文 | 在独立窗口翻译文字 | | 语音 | Windows 听写 → 翻译 → 自动填入 | Windows 听写 → 翻译 | | 阅读与界面 | 自己的中文原话 + 回答译文；输入、阅读、目录悬浮窗独立开关 | 深色窗口、置顶、复制译文 | | 翻译方向 | 中文 → 日文 / 英文；日文回复 → 中文 | 中文 → 日文 + 英文；日文 / 英文 → 中文 | | 下载文件 | **Yuqiao-Claude-v1.9.2-windows.zip** | **Yuqiao-General-v1.9.2-windows.zip** | 通用版用于没有适配的场景，不会读取或控制其他软件。两个开源版均为手动打开的便携程序，不包含自动启动、后台启动监听、总控台或系统时区修改。 ## 三步上手 1. 从 [Releases 下载页](https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate/releases/latest) 选择一个版本，**解压整个压缩包**。 2. 双击 **Yuqiao.General.exe** 或 **Yuqiao.Claude.exe**。无需安装 Python、Node.js 或大模型软件。 3. 通用版选择翻译方向并输入；Claude 版先打开 Claude Windows 客户端，选择「Claude 客户端」，开启自动翻译 / 自动填入，需要时进入悬浮模式。 语音输入先选择 Windows 中文输入法，再点「语音输入」。识别由 **Windows + H 系统听写**负责，可在系统面板结束录音。系统的语言、麦克风与在线语音设置会影响可用性。 初次使用 Claude 版，先检查自动填入的日文再自行发送。翻译有误可修改中文、检查候选，或直接编辑 Claude 中的日文；程序会避免覆盖不属于自己的草稿。 ## 适配范围 | 环境 | 当前状态 | |---|---| | Windows 11 x64 | 本地构建、自动检查及桌面功能验证环境 | | Windows 10，.NET Framework 4.8 | 目标运行环境；尚未单独完成实机验证 | | Claude Windows 客户端 | 当前重点适配，具有上述完整对话流程 | | Claude 网页 | 暂未正式支持自动跟随与填入；可用通用版独立翻译 | | macOS / Linux / Windows ARM | 未验证，不提供兼容承诺或对应安装包 | 本次发布仅以 Claude Windows 客户端作为对话集成的正式介绍对象，不将未完成流程验证的其他 AI 宣传为已支持。界面以中文为主；中英文 README 和入门说明均已提供。这是第三方独立工具，与 Anthropic、Microsoft 或 Google 无隶属关系。 ## 原理与数据 ~~~mermaid flowchart LR A[中文输入 / Windows 听写] --> B[普通在线机器翻译] B --> C[日文与英文译文] C --> D[通用窗口 / Claude 草稿] E[Claude 可见的日文回复] --> B B --> F[中文阅读窗] ~~~ Claude 版通过 Windows 的 **UI Automation（无障碍界面接口）**读取选中软件的可见文字，按对话身份同步；普通翻译服务负责语言转换，Windows 接口负责定位、显示和填入。无需大模型来“理解并操作屏幕”。 - **会联网**：待翻译文本发送到 Microsoft，失败时可能改用 Google；主动获取第二个日文候选也会使用 Google。Windows 听写可能按系统设置使用微软在线服务。 - **不保存聊天文件**：草稿、译文与近期对话索引只在内存中保留；Claude 版仅将目标软件和面板显示设置写入本机应用数据目录。 - **默认不留诊断日志**：手动启用诊断时，仅记录类型、长度、耗时和服务名称等运行信息，不记录原文、译文或录音。 - **速度取决于网络**：目标是输入停顿后数秒出现译文；不能保证每次都在 3–4 秒内完成。公共服务可能限流、失效或改变政策，没有永久免费或可用性保证。 更详细的实现、测试与数据说明见 [架构与验证 / Architecture & validation](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Windows、.NET Framework 4.8，以及 PowerShell。使用系统自带的 C# 编译器，无额外软件包依赖。 ~~~powershell .\build.ps1 .\tests\Run-Tests.ps1 .\scripts\Package.ps1 -SkipBuild ~~~ 两版程序输出至 dist/，发布压缩包输出至 release/。只构建一版可使用 **-Edition General** 或 **-Edition Claude**。 当前有 **195 项自动检查**：Claude 流程 174 项、通用版 21 项。自动检查使用模拟文字和服务，不向实际聊天发送消息；联网翻译、语音识别准确率与各软件的新版本仍需要实际使用验证。 ## 一起改进 欢迎提交适配问题、翻译流程建议与代码改进。反馈时注明 Windows 版本、目标应用版本、使用哪一版，以及可复现的操作；请先去除截图中的私人聊天和个人信息。 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) 允许使用、修改与再分发。软件许可不替代第三方翻译服务的使用条款。

# 架构与验证 / Architecture & validation

## 两个构建目标 / Two build targets

Claude 版使用 C#、WPF 和 Windows UI Automation。通用版仅编译独立窗口、机器翻译、标点整理、Windows 听写入口及单实例管理；其二进制中不包含聊天读取或自动填入实现。两版共用翻译服务，不依赖大模型、浏览器扩展或第三方 NuGet 包。

The Claude edition uses C#, WPF and Windows UI Automation. General compiles only its independent window, translation service, punctuation handling, Windows dictation entry and single-instance logic. Its binary excludes chat readers and composers. Both share a translation service and require no LLM, browser extension or third-party NuGet package.

| Source | Responsibility / 职责 |
|---|---|
| GeneralApp.cs | Independent translation window, debounce, cancellation, stale-result protection |
| App.cs, FloatingViews.cs, PanelControls.cs | Claude companion UI and independently controlled floating panels |
| TranslationService.cs, TranslationPunctuation.cs | Microsoft primary, Google fallback, bounded memory cache, target-language punctuation |
| AutomaticDraft.cs, ClaudeComposer.cs | Draft ownership, automatic Japanese filling, conflict protection |
| ConversationFlow.cs, ClaudeSend.cs, ConversationUi.cs | Explicit send requests, verification and clearing, original Chinese history |
| ConversationReadingPosition.cs | Stable reading anchor during reply updates |
| ChatWindowReader.cs, ClaudeChromeReader.cs, ClaudeSettingsReader.cs | Conversation identity and visible Claude UI extraction |
| NavigationTranslator.cs, NavigationViews.cs | Local UI vocabulary plus translated conversation titles |
| VoiceInputService.cs | Windows + H request; no recording or custom recognition engine |
| AppRuntime.cs | One manually launched instance per edition and Windows session |

## 数据边界 / Data boundaries

- Online destinations: edge.microsoft.com and translate.googleapis.com. Translation requests carry the requested text. Google fallback uses an HTTPS query containing text.
- Windows voice typing is controlled by Windows and may use Microsoft's cloud services. The application does not record audio or save audio files.
- Drafts, translations, recent chat indexes and service caches are memory-only. They are not encrypted memory.
- Claude preferences are stored in the current user's LocalApplicationData / YuqiaoTranslateStandalone folder: selected app and panel visibility only.
- Optional diagnostic output contains event kind, text length, timing and provider, not chat text. Diagnostics are disabled by default.
- Fixed UI vocabulary is translated locally; visible conversation titles may be sent to the translation service when navigation translation is enabled.
- No telemetry collector, model keys, browser credentials, automatic-start registration or system time-zone changes are implemented in these public editions.

在线请求包含待翻译文字。聊天只在内存保留，不等于加密内存或离线处理。菜单里的固定词汇在本地映射，可见会话标题可能联网翻译。Windows 听写遵循系统设置。公开源码和压缩包不包含私人配置、真实聊天或运行日志。

## 验证 / Validation

Local test environment: Windows 11 x64, .NET Framework 4.8 compiler/runtime. Windows 10, ARM, macOS and Linux have not been separately verified.

| Check group | Count | Coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| ConversationV19Probe | 37 | Explicit send, verified clearing, repeated questions, focus-related state, panel control |
| AutoFillV18Probe | 31 | Ownership, stale input, cancellation, failed lanes and conflict preservation |
| SettingsVoiceV19Probe | 24 | Settings labels and bounds, Windows dictation shortcut wiring |
| UiStateProbe | 31 | Conversation changes, pause/reconnect, initial chat migration and UI state |
| FloatingViewsProbe | 15 | Floating layout, input/read/navigation views |
| FloatingStateProbe | 14 | Panel state and disconnected behavior |
| ReadingScrollV191Probe | 22 | Question anchor, manual scrolling and streamed answer changes |
| GeneralEditionProbe | 21 | Build separation, language direction, debounce, stale results, pause, IME, copy eligibility |
| **Total** | **195** | **Synthetic, deterministic checks against the built binaries** |

These tests do not send real chat messages, use the microphone or contact translation services. Windows desktop smoke testing separately verified Chinese → Japanese + English and Japanese → Chinese using synthetic phrases. The existing Claude workflow was tested during development; the public build retains that implementation and is rechecked by the suites above. Automated checks are not proof of speech recognition accuracy or compatibility with every target-app version.

自动检查不调用麦克风、不向实际聊天发送消息，也不访问翻译服务。联网冒烟验证另外使用了合成短句。此前开发阶段验证过的 Claude 流程保留在公开版中，并重新运行上述检查。没有把自动检查当作所有软件版本均兼容的证据。

## 服务来源说明 / Service attribution

The endpoint used by the Microsoft adapter was identified while reviewing [KISS Translator's Microsoft adapter](https://github.com/fishjar/kiss-translator/blob/dev/src/builtin-plugins/microsoft.js). Yuqiao's C# implementation was written independently; it does not bundle that project's code. Public client endpoints may change and are not a service-level guarantee. Respect the providers' terms.

MIT covers this project's source and documentation. Target applications, Windows features and translation services retain their own terms.

# Yuqiao · Quick start

Extract the entire folder, then open the executable. Requires Windows, .NET Framework 4.8 and internet access. Local machine validation: Windows 11 x64.

## Claude edition: the main experience

Open Yuqiao.Claude.exe and the Claude Windows desktop app. Select “Claude 客户端”, enable automatic translation and filling, then choose “悬浮模式” (floating mode).

1. Type Chinese in Yuqiao, or select a Chinese input method and click “语音输入” (Voice input).
2. Japanese is translated and filled into Claude automatically. Review it first; only your explicit Enter requests sending.
3. Japanese replies are translated automatically in the Chinese panel on the right. Your original Chinese question is retained, and reply updates do not force you to the end.

The Chinese draft clears after the corresponding sent message is confirmed. Focus normally returns to Claude after filling; click the Chinese editor to revise the source. IME candidate confirmation does not send. Shift + Enter inserts a line break.

Input, reading and navigation panels can be hidden independently. Sidebar, profile-menu and settings translations follow visible UI elements. If changing conversations pauses the connection, use “重新连接” (Reconnect).

## General edition

Open Yuqiao.General.exe. Choose Chinese → Japanese + English, or Japanese / English → Chinese. Translation starts after roughly 0.6 seconds of inactivity; completion time depends on the network. Enter inserts a line break, “清空” clears the text, and “复制” copies a result.

General does not read or fill other applications.

## Speech and networking

The voice button opens Windows + H voice typing. Windows handles recognition; stop it from the system panel. Availability depends on language, microphone and online speech settings.

No LLM API key is required. Ordinary machine translation sends text to Microsoft / Google, and Windows dictation may also use online services. This is not an offline or API-free application.

## Troubleshooting

- Cannot launch: verify Windows and .NET Framework 4.8. The project is unsigned; download from the project release page and verify SHA256.
- Translation failure: check your connection and retry. Public translation endpoints may be limited or changed.
- Claude disconnected: open the Windows desktop client, keep the conversation visible and reconnect.
- Filling paused: check for a manually edited draft or a changed conversation. Yuqiao preserves text it does not own.
- Web, macOS or other AI apps: this automatic conversation workflow is not claimed as supported. General remains available on Windows.

The open-source editions exclude automatic startup, background launch watching, a dashboard and time-zone changes.

Project and updates: https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate

# 语桥 · 开箱即用

这是 Windows 便携软件。请先解压整个文件夹，再双击其中的程序。需要 .NET Framework 4.8 和网络连接；当前实机验证为 Windows 11 x64。

## Claude 适配版：主要体验

打开 Yuqiao.Claude.exe，同时打开 Claude Windows 客户端。选择「Claude 客户端」，勾选自动翻译和自动填入，点击「悬浮模式」。

1. 在语桥输入中文，或选择中文输入法后点击「语音输入」。
2. 翻译完成后，日文自动填入 Claude 的对话框。请检查内容；你主动按 Enter 才发送。
3. 日文回复会在右侧自动译成中文。你的中文原话也会保留，回答更新不会强制滚到末尾。

确认发送成功后，本轮中文草稿会清空。正常填入后光标回到 Claude；需要修改中文时，点回语桥输入框。中文输入法选字不触发发送，Shift + Enter 换行。

输入、阅读、目录面板可分别显示和隐藏。目录、头像菜单与设置的中文辅助内容跟随可见界面；若切换会话后暂停，请点击「重新连接」。

## 通用即时翻译版

打开 Yuqiao.General.exe，选择中文→日文+英文，或日文/英文→中文。输入停顿约 0.6 秒后开始翻译，完成时间取决于网络。Enter 换行；「清空」开始下一段；「复制」复制相应译文。

通用版不会读取或填入其他应用。

## 语音与联网

「语音输入」调用 Windows + H。语音识别由系统处理，请在系统面板结束听写。语言、麦克风和在线语音设置会影响可用性。

无需大模型 API Key。普通机器翻译仍会把待翻译文字发送到 Microsoft / Google，Windows 听写也可能联网。不要将它理解为离线或完全不使用接口。

## 遇到问题

- 无法打开：确认使用 Windows，并已具备 .NET Framework 4.8。本项目没有数字签名；请只从项目发布页下载并核对 SHA256。
- 翻译失败：检查网络，稍后重试。公共翻译服务可能限流或更改接口。
- Claude 未连接：确认打开的是 Windows 客户端，聊天界面可见，再点击重新连接。
- 填入暂停：检查 Claude 是否有你手动写的草稿、当前对话是否改变；程序会保留不属于自己的文字。
- 网页、macOS 或其他 AI：尚未承诺这套自动对话适配；可以在 Windows 上使用通用版。

开源版不包含自动启动、后台启动监听、总控台或时区修改。

项目与更新：https://github.com/zanevictor73-ai/yuqiao-translate

**中文输入，日文直达 Claude。回复一来，右侧读中文。**

语桥的重点是让翻译跟上整段对话：你打中文或说中文，日文自动填进 Claude 的对话框；你自行发送后，Claude 的日文回复在右侧同步译成中文。无需在聊天窗口和翻译网站之间反复复制粘贴。

| **Yuqiao-General-v1.9.2-windows.zip** | 独立即时翻译：中文→日文+英文，日文/英文→中文 |

解压后双击对应程序。两个包均含中英文使用说明、MIT 许可证和文件校验清单。SHA256SUMS.txt 可核对下载包完整性。

- 自动翻译与填入不发送；你主动按 Enter 才请求发送。
- 保留自己的中文原话；确认发送后清空本轮草稿，回答更新不会强制跳到末尾。
- 无需大模型 API Key；普通机器翻译与 Windows 听写仍可能联网。
- 公开版不包含自动启动、后台启动监听、总控台和时区修改。
- Windows 11 x64 是实机验证环境；Windows 10 + .NET Framework 4.8 为目标环境。macOS、Linux、ARM 和网页自动填入尚未验证。
- 195 项自动检查覆盖两个版本。其他 AI 没有作为已完成整套流程适配的对象宣传。

**Type Chinese. Japanese appears in Claude. Read replies in Chinese alongside it.**

Write or dictate Chinese, let Yuqiao fill a Japanese draft directly into Claude, then read Japanese replies translated automatically in the panel on the right. Sending stays under your control.

Choose **Claude** for the integrated Windows desktop conversation workflow, or **General** for an independent translation window. Extract the ZIP and open its executable. Both packages include Chinese/English quick-start guides, the MIT license and checksums.

No LLM API key is required; conventional translation and Windows dictation may use online services. These public editions exclude automatic startup, a launch watcher, a dashboard and time-zone changes. Windows 11 x64 was tested locally; Windows 10 with .NET Framework 4.8 is an intended runtime. No macOS, Linux, ARM or web-integration compatibility is claimed.

param([switch]$SkipBuild)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
if(-not $SkipBuild){& (Join-Path $root 'build.ps1'); & (Join-Path $root 'tests\Run-Tests.ps1')}
$version='1.9.2'
$release=Join-Path $root 'release'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $release -Force | Out-Null
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$archiveHashes=@()
foreach($edition in @('Claude','General')){
 $exe=Join-Path $root ('dist\Yuqiao.'+$edition+'.exe')
 if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)){throw "Missing $edition executable; run build.ps1 first"}
 if([Diagnostics.FileVersionInfo]::GetVersionInfo($exe).FileVersion -ne ($version+'.0')){throw 'Executable version mismatch'}
 $name='Yuqiao-'+$edition+'-v'+$version+'-windows'
 $folder=Join-Path $release $name
 New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folder -Force | Out-Null
 $files=@(
  @{Source=$exe;Name=('Yuqiao.'+$edition+'.exe')},
  @{Source=(Join-Path $root 'LICENSE');Name='LICENSE'},
  @{Source=(Join-Path $root 'docs\QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md');Name='Quick-start.zh-CN.md'},
  @{Source=(Join-Path $root 'docs\QUICKSTART.en.md');Name='Quick-start.en.md'}
 )
 foreach($file in $files){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $file.Source -Destination (Join-Path $folder $file.Name) -Force}
 # Explicit members prevent local logs/preferences from entering a release.
 $manifest=@($files | ForEach-Object {$_.Name})
 $checksums=@($manifest | ForEach-Object {((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $folder $_) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant())+'  '+$_})
 [IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $folder 'SHA256SUMS.txt'),$checksums,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
 $manifest+='SHA256SUMS.txt'
 $zip=Join-Path $release ($name+'.zip')
 if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $zip}
 $archive=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($zip,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
 try{foreach($member in $manifest){[IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($archive,(Join-Path $folder $member),($name+'/'+$member),[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null}}
 finally{$archive.Dispose()}
 $archiveHashes+=((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant())+'  '+[IO.Path]::GetFileName($zip)
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllLines((Join-Path $release 'SHA256SUMS.txt'),$archiveHashes,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$archiveHashes
